newsitem.title: UK: Odds on UK's Hague as next Conservative leader cut.
newsitem.headline: Odds on UK's Hague as next Conservative leader cut.

text.p: The odds on Welsh Secretary William Hague becoming the next leader of the ruling Conservative Party were cut on Monday to 7-1 from 20-1 after a run of bets, bookmakers William Hill said.
But Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine remains favourite to succeed John Major as Conservative leader when he steps down. Odds are as follows - Heseltine 7-2
Kenneth Clarke, Stephen Dorrell, Michael Portillo 4-1
